label: Case C — chat sample matches published scam-script patterns
e4_note: The jury may raw-emit LIKELY_SCAM_RING; contract-side _normalize_verdict downgrades to SUSPICIOUS unless confidence >= 85 AND CRITICAL flag count >= 2. See ADR 0003.

request_verification_args.chat_sample: Fell in love immediately. Need urgent help with wire transfer to unlock inheritance. Cannot video call due to operations. Please trust me and send crypto.

notes: Chat sample is a compressed version of textbook romance-scam script beats. Whether the jury lands on SUSPICIOUS or LIKELY_SCAM_RING depends on how confidently the LLM identifies the pattern. E4 is the safety net.
